payload.title: Publish from the production account with a reversible cutover
payload.description:
As the Cyclotron publication owner, I want a private-repository AWS pipeline in cyclotron-production to build and deploy a parallel site before DNS switches, so that routine main releases are automatic and the legacy site remains a rollback path.

Feature: Parallel production delivery
  Scenario: Verify target before DNS cutover
    Given cyclotron.anth.us is still served by the legacy distribution
    And cyclotron-production has a site-only pipeline connected only to AnthusAI/Cyclotron-web
    When main revision 840d4e87871b3010780d2d47e0e62024f7cd1e40 runs through the target pipeline
    Then Source, Build, and Deploy record that revision as successful
    And the target distribution serves the expected Learn guide
    And no cyclotron.anth.us DNS record changes before explicit cutover approval

Out of scope: moving the anth.us hosted zone, granting cross-account administrator access, activating the legacy connection, or deleting legacy resources.
